Precision Machining.title: Precision Machining
Precision Machining.description: Ultra-precision 5-axis CNC machined vacuum chamber bodies, showerheads, and optical alignment fixtures.
Precision Machining.applications: UHP process chambers, gas distribution manifolds, showerheads, load lock chambers.

Casting & Specialty Metals.title: Casting & Specialty Metals
Casting & Specialty Metals.description: High-integrity sand and die castings, vacuum induction melted specialty alloys, and precision forged structural frames.
Casting & Specialty Metals.applications: Chamber bases, structural support pedestals, radiation shielding, heavy equipment frames.

Welding & Frame Fabrication.title: Welding & Frame Fabrication
Welding & Frame Fabrication.description: Cleanroom Orbital TIG, Electron Beam, and Laser structural frame welding for heavy tool bases and UHP gas manifold boxes.
Welding & Frame Fabrication.applications: UHP gas stick assemblies, valve manifold boxes (VMB), heavy tool frames, sub-chassis structures.

Pumps (Vacuum & Liquid).title: Pumps (Vacuum & Liquid)
Pumps (Vacuum & Liquid).description: Turbomolecular, dry vacuum, magnetic levitation, and UHP chemical liquid transfer pumps engineered for corrosive semiconductor processes.
Pumps (Vacuum & Liquid).applications: Primary chamber evacuation, load-lock pumping, UHP liquid chemical delivery, scrubbers.

Gas Flow Controls (MFCs).title: Gas Flow Controls (MFCs)
Gas Flow Controls (MFCs).description: Ultra-high purity Mass Flow Controllers (MFCs), thermal sensors, and piezo-actuated gas metering valves for atomic scale deposition.
Gas Flow Controls (MFCs).applications: ALD/CVD gas delivery, etch chamber reactant flow, gas mixing manifolds, purging systems.

Ceramics & Quartz.title: Ceramics & Quartz
Ceramics & Quartz.description: High-purity ceramic components, CVD SiC rings, and high-purity synthetic quartzware for high-temperature and plasma processes.
Ceramics & Quartz.applications: Plasma etch chamber liners, E-Chuck top plates, focus rings, quartz tubes, diffusion boats.

Robotics & Wafer Handling.title: Robotics & Wafer Handling
Robotics & Wafer Handling.description: Atmospheric and high-vacuum wafer transfer robots, EFEM modules, vacuum end-effectors, and ultra-clean alignment stages.
Robotics & Wafer Handling.applications: Cluster tool wafer transfer, vacuum transfer chambers (VTC), sorters, EFEM front-ends.

Industrial Computers & Controllers.title: Industrial Computers & Controllers
Industrial Computers & Controllers.description: Real-time industrial PCs, EtherCAT motion controllers, FPGA interface boards, and sub-nanometer deterministic control nodes.
Industrial Computers & Controllers.applications: Main tool controller, plasma power timing units, sensor aggregation, SECS/GEM interface.

PCBAs & EMS Integrators.title: PCBAs & EMS Integrators
PCBAs & EMS Integrators.description: High-Density Interconnect (HDI) rigid-flex PCB assemblies, RF power control boards, and complex EMS system box builds.
PCBAs & EMS Integrators.applications: RF matching networks, generator controllers, optical sensor interface, tool power distribution.

Cables & Harnesses.title: Cables & Harnesses
Cables & Harnesses.description: Ultra-flexible, low-outgassing cleanroom cable assemblies, high-frequency RF feedthrough lines, and complex power harnesses.
Cables & Harnesses.applications: Wafer handling robotic arms, RF generator connections, motion control drag chains.

Sensors & Metrology.title: Sensors & Metrology
Sensors & Metrology.description: Capacitance manometers (Baratron), laser displacement sensors, optical spectrum analyzers, and sub-nanometer position encoders.
Sensors & Metrology.applications: Chamber pressure monitoring, wafer alignment metrology, stage position feedback, inspection.

Vacuum Valves.title: Vacuum Valves
Vacuum Valves.description: High-vacuum and ultra-high vacuum pendulum valves, gate valves, control valves, and UHP gas isolation valves.
Vacuum Valves.applications: Etch/CVD chamber isolation, load-lock slit valves, pressure control throttling.

RF Generators.title: RF Generators
RF Generators.description: Solid-state RF power generators, automatic impedance matching networks, and pulsed DC plasma power supplies.
RF Generators.applications: Plasma generation for etch, CVD, ALD, sputtering, and chamber cleaning.

Turnkey Integrators.title: Turnkey Integrators
Turnkey Integrators.description: Full sub-system turnkey assembly, UHP cleanroom integration, sub-fab module build, and final functional tool testing.
Turnkey Integrators.applications: Complete etch/CVD sub-assemblies, vacuum transfer modules, gas boxes, frame integrations.
